title: Maintaining Composure During Public Criticism
paragraphs: Selama forum komunitas publik, Aiman menghadapi kritik yang tak terduga keras terhadap proyek yang ia pimpin, disampaikan oleh anggota audiens yang nadanya mendekati serangan pribadi alih-alih masukan profesional yang membangun.

Merasakan sikap defensifnya langsung meningkat, Aiman secara sadar berhenti sejenak sebelum merespons, menahan dorongan alami untuk menyamai nada keras pengkritik dengan bantahan yang sama tajamnya di depan audiens yang berkumpul.

Sebagai gantinya, ia mengakui substansi yang sah yang terkubur dalam kritik yang disampaikan dengan keras itu, mengatasi kekhawatiran yang sah secara langsung sambil dengan sengaja menolak merespons cara yang tidak sopan itu disampaikan.

Beberapa anggota audiens kemudian mendekati Aiman secara pribadi untuk memuji responsnya yang tenang, mencatat bahwa pengendalian dirinya di bawah provokasi publik justru memperkuat alih-alih mengurangi kredibilitasnya di dalam ruangan itu.
answerKey: During a public community forum, Aiman faced unexpectedly harsh criticism of a project he had led, delivered by an audience member whose tone bordered on personal attack rather than constructive professional feedback. Feeling his defensiveness rising immediately, Aiman consciously paused before responding, resisting the natural impulse to match the critic's harsh tone with an equally sharp rebuttal in front of the assembled audience. He instead acknowledged the valid substance buried within the harshly delivered criticism, addressing the legitimate concern directly while deliberately declining to respond to the disrespectful manner in which it had been presented. Several audience members later approached Aiman privately to commend his composed response, noting that his restraint under public provocation had actually strengthened rather than diminished his credibility within the room.
